mentions.context_excerpt: AI enthusiasts and developers can easily get started with AI using NVIDIA NIM — prepackaged, optimized AI models that can run in popular apps like AnythingLLM, Microsoft VS Code and ComfyUI. Releasing this week, the FLUX.1-schnell image generation model will be available as a NIM microservice, and the popular FLUX.1-dev NIM microservice has been updated to support more RTX GPUs.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Those looking for a simple, no-code way to dive into AI development can tap into Project G-Assist — the RTX PC AI assistant in the NVIDIA app — to build plug-ins to control PC apps and peripherals using natural language AI. New community plug-ins are now available, including Google Gemini web search, Spotify, Twitch, IFTTT and SignalRGB.
